summary: New York City, software developer, strong advocate for open-source software, passionate about DRM-free gaming, critical of corporate monopolies, supports Linux and open standards, engaged in discussions about digital rights and privacy, prefers GOG over Steam for gaming, interested in XMPP and decentralized communication, skeptical of major tech companies' motives, believes in mutual respect between consumers and content creators, critical of DRM and its implications for user privacy and experience, prefers using Vim for text editing, actively participates in discussions about patent reform and software patents, values ethical considerations in technology and media distribution.
